items.rss_summary: The US is sending a new aircraft carrier to replace the USS Lincoln in the Middle East according to the Wall Street Journal. The ship has been deployed for 250 days. Also there are new worries about the size of America's weapons stockpile as talks to end the war with Iran seem to be at a standstill. Bloomberg's Tyler Kendall reports on it all from the White House on "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.rss_summary: President Donald Trump explains why he secretly got off Air Force One in Turkey and then took off on another plane to England. The switch took place on July 8 in Ankara where Trump attended a NATO summit. On Aug. 11, Trump told reporters that the Secret Service and military made the decision for him to switch planes in response to unspecified safety threats.
